description: This is the main activity class for an Android application. It manages a navigation drawer, bottom navigation, and fragment transactions for different sections like Home, Dashboard, and Settings. It handles UI setup, navigation events, state restoration, and back press behavior.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing navigation, fragments, and UI state in the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, restores state, and configures navigation behavior.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current selected item ID to restore UI state after configuration changes.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Provides support for navigation 'up' action, opens the drawer.

methods.name: setupNavigationListeners
methods.description: Configures listeners for bottom navigation and drawer navigation.

methods.name: ensureFragmentsCreated
methods.description: Creates or restores the fragments associated with each tab.

methods.name: showDestination
methods.description: Displays the selected fragment and updates UI titles and selections.

methods.name: normalizeDestinationId
methods.description: Maps incoming menu IDs to standard destination IDs.

methods.name: syncNavigationSelection
methods.description: Synchronizes navigation UI components to reflect the current selection.
